description: Active published bundle on the store where every active child has stock for quantityUsed x its bundle quantity and a DisablePurchasing child has less than exceedQuantity x it, so the cart shows 'Exceeding the available quantity'.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test adds to cart and checks out with; it must be available

exceedQuantity.description: Cart quantity the test sets to get the exceeding-quantity message; the available bundle quantity must be below it
